task.title: Replace persona router and web placeholder runtime behavior
task.summary_zh: 把 persona service router web channel 的 repo-local placeholder runtime 行為換成 OpenClaw-backed 正常路徑或 truthful degraded surrogate，關掉明顯的 stub 假完成。
acceptance: Persona service stops returning the static not ready stub in the normal path
Router no longer relies on local placeholder classification as authoritative behavior
Web stream path is backed by truthful runtime events or an explicit degraded contract
task.next: Captured the approved runtime integration on commits 4fe02c0 and 156f94d after re-running persona/router/web tests (7+7+3). Persona invoke now uses the OpenClaw-backed path with truthful degraded surrogate, router treats persona /classify as authoritative with degraded fallback only, and web /stream emits explicit status-only SSE events instead of the old placeholder.
review_notes_zh: Persona /invoke 改走 OpenClaw gateway 實際 agent_turn，失敗時只回 [persona runtime degraded] 明示 surrogate 並把 session 標 degraded
Router /route 先呼叫 persona /classify，local classifier 只在 except 分支以 router.degraded_fallback / degraded_surrogate 出現，/health 公告 classification_owner=persona、fallback_classifier_mode=degraded_only
Web /stream 發出 session + router_health + notice(streaming=disabled) 三個 truthful SSE event，/chat 傳遞 router metadata 並在 router 失敗時明示 routing_mode=degraded_surrogate
Adapter agent_turn 遇非 JSON stdout 回 {text: stdout} 不偽造結構化成功，transport 錯誤以 OpenClawGatewayTransportError + Pantheon 錯誤碼往上拋
獨立重跑 persona 7 passed (3 subtests) / router 7 passed / web 3 passed，四檔 ast.parse 全過

Non-blocking: persona /classify 仍是 local surrogate、web SSE 僅 status_only、router except 較寬、sessions_overview 尚未接線、四個 artifact 檔在 codex/2026-04-21-exec-sync 工作樹未 commit 也未 push，owner 於 finalize 時處理 commit/push
